pictures.author: Bgag / Bernard Gagnon
pictures.observed: Actually viewed courtyard panorama:two ribbed blue domes on decorated cylindrical drums,brick walls with sparse pointed blind fields,large tiled portal/tower fabric,open courtyard and low archaeological remains. The panorama supplies the compound character and ribbed side-dome treatment;unseen courtyard foundations and exact conservation state remain unverified.

pictures.author: Bgag / Bernard Gagnon
pictures.observed: Actually viewed western dome:a broad smooth turquoise cap over a decorated cylindrical drum,blue/pale bands and a lower arcade/frieze. The model distinguishes this smooth main cap from the ribbed side domes. Original sparse geometric bands abstract the colors;no photographed tile art or calligraphy is copied.

pictures.author: Tim Adams
pictures.observed: Actually viewed monumental prayer portal obliquely:paired very tall cylindrical tiled pylons,deep pointed iwan,recessed decorated backing,pale stone plinths and blue/cream geometric tile fields. Main western screen/towers follow this treatment. Eastern passage,unseen backs and exact damage/door arrangements remain approximate.
